## 1. CRITICAL PATH

The critical path for this week’s commitments is:

**Billing schema migration (Elena, 3h)** → **SSO API compatibility patch (Marcus, 4h)** → **SSO regression (QA, 2h)** → **SSO production rollout (Marcus, 1h)**

This path determines the earliest delivery of Enterprise SSO (Atlas commitment, Wednesday EOD).  
The Contoso compliance export (Tuesday 16:00) shares the first step (billing migration) but then branches into a shorter path: **permission patch (Daniel, 3.5h)** → **compliance export (Julia, 1h)**. That path can be completed on Monday, well before the deadline.

## 2. MY PLAN FOR TODAY (Monday)

| Time | Action | Owner |
|------|--------|-------|
| 09:00 | Start billing schema migration | Elena |
| 09:00 | Start pricing page | Sarah |
| 09:00 | Start Contoso export formatter (date format) | Julia |
| 12:00 | Migration done → Elena kicks off backfill (1.5h) | Elena |
| 12:00 | Marcus walks Daniel through delegated-admin path (0.5h) | Marcus |
| 12:30 | Daniel starts Contoso permission patch (3.5h) | Daniel |
| 12:30 | Marcus starts SSO API compatibility patch (4h) | Marcus |
| 13:30 | Backfill done → Sarah starts board pack revenue charts (2h) | Sarah |
| 12:00–13:30 | Sarah builds packaging approval pack (1.5h) after pricing page | Sarah |
| 16:00 | Daniel finishes permission patch → Julia starts compliance export (1h) | Julia |
| 16:30 | Marcus finishes API patch → QA regression scheduled for Tuesday 09:00 | QA |

**Delegate/unblock:**  
- Ensure Elena starts migration immediately (no waiting).  
- Confirm Marcus and Daniel coordinate at 12:00 for the walkthrough.  
- Book QA regression slot for Tuesday morning.  
- Sarah submits packaging approval pack after 13:30 (approval will be next day).

## 3. PARALLEL WORK

- **Contoso export formatter** (Julia) – independent, done Monday morning.  
- **Pricing page** (Sarah) – independent, done Monday morning.  
- **Board pack non-revenue** (Sarah) – can be done any time before Friday.  
- **Onboarding instrumentation** (Marcus) – not a blocker, can be deferred.  
- **Onboarding launch** (Julia) – not urgent, can be done later in the week.

## 4. BLOCKERS & DEPENDENCIES

**Blockers:**  
- Billing schema migration is the critical blocker for both Contoso permission patch and SSO API patch.  
- Contoso permission patch also requires a 0.5h walkthrough from Marcus (if Daniel does it).  
- SSO regression depends on API patch; SSO rollout depends on regression.  
- Board pack revenue depends on backfill (which depends on migration).  
- Packaging approval pack depends on pricing page.

**Unblocked:**  
- Security review is closed (email from Maya) – no longer a blocker.  
- Contoso export “broken” issue is resolved (format only, not blocking).  
- Onboarding instrumentation is no longer a launch blocker (Julia confirmed).

## 5. EARLIEST DELIVERY

- **Enterprise SSO:** Tuesday 14:00 (after Marcus’s Atlas session ends at 13:00).  
  - Migration finishes Monday 12:00 → API patch 12:30–16:30 → QA regression Tuesday 09:00–11:00 → rollout Tuesday 13:00–14:00.  
- **Contoso compliance export:** Monday 17:00 (well before Tuesday 16:00 deadline).  
- **Pricing page approval:** Tuesday (submitted Monday after 12:00, cleared Tuesday morning).  
- **Board pack:** Friday 10:00 (revenue charts done Monday afternoon).

## 6. RISKS / UNKNOWNS

- QA regression may uncover issues requiring rework – could push SSO rollout to Wednesday.  
- Daniel’s permission patch might take longer than 3.5h; if so, Contoso export could slip to Tuesday morning (still before deadline).  
- Backfill could fail or take longer, delaying board pack revenue charts.  
- Packaging approval might not be granted on Tuesday if the committee has questions.  
- Marcus’s API patch could have hidden dependencies not mentioned (e.g., environment issues).  
- We assume no other urgent escalations appear during the day.
